proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: closedness descends along the fpqc morphism G_{k'} -> G for a perfect extension, so assume k perfect and pass to the reductions (which stay subgroup schemes); the reduced closure Z of i(G') has Z x_k Z equal to the closure of the product image (047B), so multiplication lands in Z and Z is a reduced closed subgroup scheme; inside Z the image i(G') is an open subgroup scheme, hence closed (047S), so i(G') = Z is closed (source lines 1104-1129)
